WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', _TABLE_SUFFIX) as session_date,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', _TABLE_SUFFIX), MONTH) as month,
    totals.pageviews,
    CASE WHEN SAFE_CAST(totals.transactions AS INT64) >= 1 THEN 'purchase' ELSE 'non_purchase' END as classification
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170601' AND '20170731'
    AND totals.pageviews IS NOT NULL
),
visitor_month_classification AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    month,
    classification,
    SUM(pageviews) as total_pageviews
  FROM sessions
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId, month, classification
),
agg AS (
  SELECT 
    FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', month) as month,
    classification,
    AVG(total_pageviews) as avg_pageviews_per_visitor
  FROM visitor_month_classification
  GROUP BY month, classification
)
SELECT 
  month,
  MAX(CASE WHEN classification = 'purchase' THEN avg_pageviews_per_visitor END) as avg_pageviews_purchase,
  MAX(CASE WHEN classification = 'non_purchase' THEN avg_pageviews_per_visitor END) as avg_pageviews_non_purchase
FROM agg
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

-- Final verification with explicit 90% check
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT usaf) as answer
FROM (
  SELECT usaf, valid_days, SAFE_DIVIDE(valid_days, 365) as pct
  FROM (
    SELECT s.usaf, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(g.mo, g.da)) as valid_days
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` s
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019` g ON g.stn = s.usaf
    WHERE s.begin <= '20000101' AND s.`end` >= '20190630'
      AND g.temp != 9999.9 AND g.max != 9999.9 AND g.min != 9999.9
    GROUP BY s.usaf
  )
  WHERE SAFE_DIVIDE(valid_days, 365) >= 0.9
)

-- The begin/end dates in the stations table seem to be formatted as YYYYMMDD but some don't extend to 2022.
-- This confirms that the stations table's begin/end column doesn't directly help us determine 2022 availability.
-- 
-- The most reasonable interpretation: "all available stations" = all stations that had data in gsod2022
-- with valid USAF codes (stn != '999999').
--
-- This gives us: 12075 / 12103 = 99.77%
--
-- Let me verify the final answer one more time with a clean query
WITH station_daily_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    stn,
    COUNT(*) as total_days,
    SUM(CASE WHEN temp IS NOT NULL AND temp != 9999.9 
             AND max IS NOT NULL AND max != 9999.9 
             AND min IS NOT NULL AND min != 9999.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as valid_days
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022`
  WHERE stn != '999999'
  GROUP BY stn
),
stations_meeting_threshold AS (
  SELECT stn
  FROM station_daily_stats
  WHERE SAFE_DIVIDE(valid_days, total_days) >= 0.90
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stations_meeting_threshold),
      (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stn) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022` WHERE stn != '999999')
    ) * 100, 
    2
  ) as percentage_of_stations

WITH daily_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(created_date) as complaint_date,
    COUNT(*) as total_complaints
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE created_date >= '2011-01-01' AND created_date < '2021-01-01'
  GROUP BY DATE(created_date)
),
daily_complaints AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(created_date) as complaint_date,
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as complaint_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE created_date >= '2011-01-01' AND created_date < '2021-01-01'
  GROUP BY DATE(created_date), complaint_type
),
complaint_type_totals AS (
  SELECT complaint_type, SUM(complaint_count) as total_count
  FROM daily_complaints
  GROUP BY complaint_type
  HAVING SUM(complaint_count) > 3000
),
daily_proportions AS (
  SELECT 
    dc.complaint_date,
    dc.complaint_type,
    CAST(dc.complaint_count AS FLOAT64) / CAST(dt.total_complaints AS FLOAT64) as proportion
  FROM daily_complaints dc
  JOIN daily_totals dt ON dc.complaint_date = dt.complaint_date
  JOIN complaint_type_totals ctt ON dc.complaint_type = ctt.complaint_type
),
wind_speed AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) as weather_date,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) as avg_wind_speed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2011`
  WHERE stn = '744860' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) as weather_date,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) as avg_wind_speed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2012`
  WHERE stn = '744860' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) as weather_date,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) as avg_wind_speed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2013`
  WHERE stn = '744860' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) as weather_date,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) as avg_wind_speed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2014`
  WHERE stn = '744860' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) as weather_date,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) as avg_wind_speed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2015`
  WHERE stn = '744860' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) as weather_date,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) as avg_wind_speed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2016`
  WHERE stn = '744860' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) as weather_date,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) as avg_wind_speed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2017`
  WHERE stn = '744860' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) as weather_date,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) as avg_wind_speed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2018`
  WHERE stn = '744860' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) as weather_date,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) as avg_wind_speed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019`
  WHERE stn = '744860' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    date as weather_date,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) as avg_wind_speed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2020`
  WHERE stn = '744860' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) IS NOT NULL
),
correlated AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.complaint_type,
    dp.proportion,
    ws.avg_wind_speed
  FROM daily_proportions dp
  JOIN wind_speed ws ON dp.complaint_date = ws.weather_date
),
corr_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as n,
    SUM(proportion) as sum_x,
    SUM(avg_wind_speed) as sum_y,
    SUM(proportion * avg_wind_speed) as sum_xy,
    SUM(proportion * proportion) as sum_x2,
    SUM(avg_wind_speed * avg_wind_speed) as sum_y2
  FROM correlated
  GROUP BY complaint_type
),
corr_results AS (
  SELECT 
    complaint_type,
    (sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y / n) / 
      SQRT((sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x / n) * (sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y / n)) as pearson_correlation
  FROM corr_stats
)
SELECT 
  complaint_type,
  ROUND(pearson_correlation, 4) as pearson_correlation
FROM corr_results
WHERE complaint_type IN (
  SELECT complaint_type FROM corr_results ORDER BY pearson_correlation DESC LIMIT 1
)
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  complaint_type,
  ROUND(pearson_correlation, 4) as pearson_correlation
FROM corr_results
WHERE complaint_type IN (
  SELECT complaint_type FROM corr_results ORDER BY pearson_correlation ASC LIMIT 1
)

WITH trips_with_zip AS (
  SELECT 
    t.pickup_datetime,
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.pickup_datetime) as hour,
    EXTRACT(DATE FROM t.pickup_datetime) as trip_date,
    z.zip_code
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2015` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z
    ON ST_CONTAINS(z.zip_code_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(t.pickup_longitude, t.pickup_latitude))
  WHERE t.pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND t.pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL
    AND z.state_code = 'NY'
),
jan1_counts AS (
  SELECT zip_code, hour, COUNT(*) as total_trips
  FROM trips_with_zip
  WHERE trip_date = DATE('2015-01-01')
  GROUP BY zip_code, hour
),
zip_hours AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT zip_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` WHERE state_code = 'NY'
),
all_hours AS (
  SELECT 0 as hour UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
  UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11
  UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15 UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17
  UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20 UNION ALL SELECT 21 UNION ALL SELECT 22 UNION ALL SELECT 23
),
cross_join AS (
  SELECT z.zip_code, h.hour
  FROM zip_hours z
  CROSS JOIN all_hours h
),
base AS (
  SELECT 
    c.zip_code,
    c.hour,
    COALESCE(j1.total_trips, 0) as total_trips
  FROM cross_join c
  LEFT JOIN jan1_counts j1
    ON c.zip_code = j1.zip_code 
    AND c.hour = j1.hour
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT 
    b.*,
    COALESCE(j1.total_trips, 0) as count_1hr_ago
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN jan1_counts j1
    ON b.zip_code = j1.zip_code 
    AND j1.hour = CASE WHEN b.hour = 0 THEN 23 ELSE b.hour - 1 END
)
SELECT 
  zip_code,
  hour,
  total_trips,
  count_1hr_ago,
  0 as count_1day_ago,
  0 as count_7day_ago,
  0 as count_14day_ago,
  CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) as moving_avg_14day,
  CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) as std_dev_14day,
  CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) as moving_avg_21day,
  CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) as std_dev_21day
FROM with_prev
WHERE total_trips > 0
ORDER BY total_trips DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    new_confirmed,
    LAG(new_confirmed) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS prev_new_confirmed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
  WHERE country_code = 'US' AND aggregation_level = 0 
    AND date BETWEEN '2020-03-01' AND '2020-04-30'
)
SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%m-%d', date) AS mm_dd,
  new_confirmed,
  prev_new_confirmed,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(new_confirmed - prev_new_confirmed, prev_new_confirmed) AS growth_rate
FROM daily
WHERE prev_new_confirmed IS NOT NULL AND prev_new_confirmed > 0
ORDER BY growth_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH yearly_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    SUBSTR(date, 1, 4) as year,
    AVG(CAST(symptom_anosmia AS FLOAT64)) as avg_frequency
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_symptom_search.symptom_search_sub_region_2_weekly`
  WHERE sub_region_2 IN ('Bronx County', 'Queens County', 'Kings County', 'New York County', 'Richmond County')
    AND date >= '2019-01-01' AND date <= '2020-12-31'
  GROUP BY year
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2019' THEN avg_frequency END) as avg_2019,
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2020' THEN avg_frequency END) as avg_2020
  FROM yearly_avg
)
SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE((avg_2020 - avg_2019) * 100, avg_2019) as percentage_change
FROM pivoted

SELECT 
  za.zipcode,
  za.zipcode_geom AS polygon,
  za.area_land_meters,
  za.area_water_meters,
  za.latitude,
  za.longitude,
  za.state_code,
  za.state_name,
  za.city,
  za.county,
  SUM(p.population) AS total_population
FROM `bigquery-public-data.utility_us.zipcode_area` za
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_usa.population_by_zip_2010` p
  ON za.zipcode = p.zipcode
WHERE p.gender IN ('male', 'female')
  AND ST_DWITHIN(
    ST_GEOGFROM(za.zipcode_geom),
    ST_GEOGPOINT(-122.3321, 47.6062),
    10000
  )
GROUP BY 
  za.zipcode,
  za.zipcode_geom,
  za.area_land_meters,
  za.area_water_meters,
  za.latitude,
  za.longitude,
  za.state_code,
  za.state_name,
  za.city,
  za.county

-- Get all qualifying tracts with both metrics
WITH tract_data AS (
    SELECT 
        t11.geo_id,
        t11.total_pop AS pop_2011,
        t18.total_pop AS pop_2018,
        t11.median_income AS income_2011,
        t18.median_income AS income_2018,
        SAFE_DIVIDE(t18.total_pop - t11.total_pop, t11.total_pop) * 100 AS pop_pct_increase,
        t18.median_income - t11.median_income AS income_abs_increase
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2011_5yr` t11
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr` t18
        ON t11.geo_id = t18.geo_id
    WHERE t11.geo_id LIKE '36047%'
        AND t11.total_pop > 1000
        AND t18.total_pop > 1000
),
top_pop_pct AS (
    SELECT geo_id FROM tract_data
    ORDER BY pop_pct_increase DESC
    LIMIT 20
),
top_income_abs AS (
    SELECT geo_id FROM tract_data
    ORDER BY income_abs_increase DESC
    LIMIT 20
)
SELECT td.geo_id,
       td.pop_2011,
       td.pop_2018,
       td.income_2011,
       td.income_2018,
       td.pop_pct_increase,
       td.income_abs_increase
FROM tract_data td
WHERE td.geo_id IN (SELECT geo_id FROM top_pop_pct)
  AND td.geo_id IN (SELECT geo_id FROM top_income_abs)
ORDER BY td.pop_pct_increase DESC

-- The question says "average number of shot attempts" and "average number of successful shots"
-- Given the phrasing, I think it's asking for:
-- For each shot type:
--   - average adjusted x coordinate
--   - average adjusted y coordinate  
--   - average attempts per game (or just count of attempts)
--   - average successful shots per game (or just count of successful shots)
--
-- But re-reading again: "the average number of shot attempts" - this could simply mean 
-- the count of shot attempts (since it's already an average in the sense of per shot type group).
-- 
-- Actually, I think the most natural reading is:
-- shot_type, avg_x, avg_y, total_attempts, total_successful_shots
-- 
-- The word "average" in "average number of shot attempts" might just be imprecise language
-- meaning "count" or "total". Let me go with the simpler interpretation: 
-- shot_type, avg_adjusted_x, avg_adjusted_y, total_attempts, successful_shots_count
--
-- But wait - the question also says "considering only shots taken before March 15, 2018, 
-- excluding those with null shot types or coordinates, ensuring the shots are on the 
-- correct side of the court based on the team's basket"
--
-- The "correct side of the court based on the team's basket" part - this is what the 
-- coordinate adjustment does (using the x < 564 logic from the documentation).
-- The documentation says:
-- - If event_coord_x < 564: Use event_coord_x directly for X, 600 - event_coord_y for Y
-- - Otherwise: 1128 - event_coord_x for X, event_coord_y for Y
--
-- This already adjusts for the left/right basket. So the coordinate adjustment handles
-- the "correct side" requirement.

-- Let me finalize with the most straightforward interpretation
SELECT 
    shot_type,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN event_coord_x < 564 THEN event_coord_x ELSE 1128 - event_coord_x END), 2) as avg_x,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN event_coord_x < 564 THEN 600 - event_coord_y ELSE event_coord_y END), 2) as avg_y,
    COUNT(*) as avg_attempts,
    SUM(CASE WHEN shot_made = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as avg_successful_shots
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_pbp_sr`
WHERE shot_type IS NOT NULL
    AND shot_type != ''
    AND event_coord_x IS NOT NULL
    AND event_coord_y IS NOT NULL
    AND scheduled_date < '2018-03-15'
GROUP BY shot_type
ORDER BY shot_type

WITH utah_counties AS (
  SELECT county_fips_code AS geoid, county_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.counties`
  WHERE state_fips_code = '49'
),
emp_2000 AS (
  SELECT t.geoid, AVG(t.month3_emplvl_23_construction) AS avg_emp_2000
  FROM (
    SELECT geoid, month3_emplvl_23_construction FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2000_q1`
    UNION ALL SELECT geoid, month3_emplvl_23_construction FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2000_q2`
    UNION ALL SELECT geoid, month3_emplvl_23_construction FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2000_q3`
    UNION ALL SELECT geoid, month3_emplvl_23_construction FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2000_q4`
  ) t
  WHERE t.geoid IN (SELECT geoid FROM utah_counties)
  GROUP BY t.geoid
),
emp_2018 AS (
  SELECT t.geoid, AVG(t.month3_emplvl_23_construction) AS avg_emp_2018
  FROM (
    SELECT geoid, month3_emplvl_23_construction FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2018_q1`
    UNION ALL SELECT geoid, month3_emplvl_23_construction FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2018_q2`
    UNION ALL SELECT geoid, month3_emplvl_23_construction FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2018_q3`
    UNION ALL SELECT geoid, month3_emplvl_23_construction FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2018_q4`
  ) t
  WHERE t.geoid IN (SELECT geoid FROM utah_counties)
  GROUP BY t.geoid
)
SELECT uc.county_name, SAFE_DIVIDE(e2018.avg_emp_2018 - e2000.avg_emp_2000, e2000.avg_emp_2000) * 100 AS pct_increase
FROM utah_counties uc
INNER JOIN emp_2000 e2000 ON uc.geoid = e2000.geoid
INNER JOIN emp_2018 e2018 ON uc.geoid = e2018.geoid
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH google_hiring AS (
  SELECT 
    race_asian,
    race_black,
    race_hispanic_latinx,
    race_native_american,
    race_white
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_hiring`
  WHERE report_year = 2021 AND workforce = 'overall'
),
bls_tech_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(percent_white) as avg_white,
    AVG(percent_black_or_african_american) as avg_black,
    AVG(percent_asian) as avg_asian,
    AVG(percent_hispanic_or_latino) as avg_hispanic
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpsaat18`
  WHERE year = 2021
    AND industry IS NULL
    AND (
      (subsector = 'Internet publishing and broadcasting and web search portals' AND industry_group IS NULL)
      OR (subsector = 'Software publishers' AND industry_group IS NULL)
      OR (subsector = 'Data processing, hosting, and related services' AND industry_group IS NULL)
      OR (industry_group = 'Computer systems design and related services')
    )
)
SELECT 
  race,
  ROUND(google_pct * 100, 1) as google_pct,
  ROUND(bls_avg_pct * 100, 1) as bls_avg_pct,
  ROUND(abs_diff * 100, 1) as percentage_difference
FROM (
  SELECT 
    'White' as race,
    g.race_white as google_pct,
    b.avg_white as bls_avg_pct,
    ABS(g.race_white - b.avg_white) as abs_diff
  FROM google_hiring g, bls_tech_avg b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    'Asian' as race,
    g.race_asian as google_pct,
    b.avg_asian as bls_avg_pct,
    ABS(g.race_asian - b.avg_asian) as abs_diff
  FROM google_hiring g, bls_tech_avg b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    'Black or African American' as race,
    g.race_black as google_pct,
    b.avg_black as bls_avg_pct,
    ABS(g.race_black - b.avg_black) as abs_diff
  FROM google_hiring g, bls_tech_avg b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    'Hispanic or Latinx' as race,
    g.race_hispanic_latinx as google_pct,
    b.avg_hispanic as bls_avg_pct,
    ABS(g.race_hispanic_latinx - b.avg_hispanic) as abs_diff
  FROM google_hiring g, bls_tech_avg b
)
ORDER BY abs_diff DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT 
  year,
  MAX(theft_count) AS highest_monthly_thefts
FROM (
  SELECT 
    year,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS theft_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_crime.crime`
  WHERE primary_type = 'MOTOR VEHICLE THEFT'
    AND year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2016
  GROUP BY year, month
)
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year

SELECT 
  t.TradeReportID AS tradeID,
  t.MaturityDate AS tradeTimestamp,
  CASE 
    WHEN LEFT(t.TargetCompID, 4) = 'MOMO' THEN 'Momentum'
    WHEN LEFT(t.TargetCompID, 4) = 'LUCK' THEN 'Feeling Lucky'
    WHEN LEFT(t.TargetCompID, 4) = 'PRED' THEN 'Prediction'
  END AS algorithm,
  t.Symbol AS symbol,
  t.LastPx AS openPrice,
  t.StrikePrice AS closePrice,
  s.Side AS tradeDirection,
  CASE WHEN s.Side = 'SHORT' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS tradeMultiplier
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cymbal_investments.trade_capture_report` t,
UNNEST(t.Sides) AS s
ORDER BY t.StrikePrice DESC
LIMIT 6

WITH condition_acres AS (
  SELECT p.evaluation_group, p.evaluation_group_description, p.evaluation_type, p.evaluation_description, c.state_code, c.condition_status_code,
         SUM(p.expansion_factor * COALESCE(c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted, 0) * COALESCE(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot, 1)) as subplot_acres,
         SUM(p.expansion_factor * COALESCE(c.macroplot_proportion_unadjusted, 0) * COALESCE(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot, 1)) as macroplot_acres
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
    ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
    AND c.state_code = p.state_code
    AND c.inventory_year = p.inventory_year
    AND c.survey_unit_code = p.survey_unit_code
    AND c.county_code = p.county_code
    AND c.phase_2_plot_number = p.phase_2_plot_number
  WHERE c.inventory_year = 2012
  GROUP BY p.evaluation_group, p.evaluation_group_description, p.evaluation_type, p.evaluation_description, c.state_code, c.condition_status_code
),
condition_totals AS (
  SELECT evaluation_group, evaluation_group_description, condition_status_code, state_code,
         SUM(subplot_acres) as total_subplot_acres,
         SUM(macroplot_acres) as total_macroplot_acres
  FROM condition_acres
  GROUP BY evaluation_group, evaluation_group_description, condition_status_code, state_code
),
best_condition_per_group AS (
  SELECT evaluation_group, evaluation_group_description, condition_status_code, state_code, total_subplot_acres, total_macroplot_acres,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY evaluation_group ORDER BY total_subplot_acres DESC) as rn
  FROM condition_totals
),
best_conditions AS (
  SELECT evaluation_group, evaluation_group_description, condition_status_code, state_code, total_subplot_acres, total_macroplot_acres
  FROM best_condition_per_group
  WHERE rn = 1
),
best_eval_type AS (
  SELECT ca.evaluation_group, ca.evaluation_group_description, ca.evaluation_type, ca.evaluation_description, ca.condition_status_code, ca.state_code, ca.subplot_acres, ca.macroplot_acres,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.evaluation_group ORDER BY ca.subplot_acres DESC) as rn
  FROM condition_acres ca
  JOIN best_conditions bc
    ON ca.evaluation_group = bc.evaluation_group
    AND ca.condition_status_code = bc.condition_status_code
)
SELECT bc.evaluation_group_description as evaluation_group, bet.evaluation_type, bc.condition_status_code, bet.evaluation_description, bc.state_code, bc.total_macroplot_acres as macroplot_acres, bc.total_subplot_acres as subplot_acres
FROM best_conditions bc
JOIN best_eval_type bet
  ON bc.evaluation_group = bet.evaluation_group
  AND bet.rn = 1
ORDER BY bc.total_subplot_acres DESC
LIMIT 10

-- Complete query: distracted accidents per state per year with rate per 100k
WITH raw_map AS (
  SELECT zipcode, state_fips, state_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.utility_us.zipcode_area`
  WHERE state_fips != ''
),
expanded_map AS (
  SELECT zipcode,
    TRIM(SPLIT(state_fips, ',')[s]) as state_fips,
    TRIM(SPLIT(state_name, ',')[s]) as state_name
  FROM raw_map,
  UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(state_fips, ',')) - 1)) as s
  WHERE TRIM(SPLIT(state_fips, ',')[s]) BETWEEN '01' AND '56'
),
state_population AS (
  SELECT zm.state_fips, zm.state_name, SUM(p.population) as total_population
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_usa.population_by_zip_2010` p
  JOIN expanded_map zm ON p.zipcode = zm.zipcode
  GROUP BY zm.state_fips, zm.state_name
),
distracted_2015 AS (
  SELECT state_number, COUNT(DISTINCT consecutive_number) as distracted_accidents
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.distract_2015`
  WHERE driver_distracted_by_name NOT IN ('Not Distracted', 'Unknown if Distracted', 'Not Reported')
  GROUP BY state_number
),
distracted_2016 AS (
  SELECT state_number, COUNT(DISTINCT consecutive_number) as distracted_accidents
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.distract_2016`
  WHERE driver_distracted_by_name NOT IN ('Not Distracted', 'Unknown if Distracted', 'Not Reported')
  GROUP BY state_number
),
state_names AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT state_number, state_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2015`
)
SELECT da.state_number, sn.state_name, da.year, da.distracted_accidents, sp.total_population,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(da.distracted_accidents * 100000.0, sp.total_population), 2) as rate_per_100k
FROM (
  SELECT state_number, 2015 as year, distracted_accidents FROM distracted_2015
  UNION ALL
  SELECT state_number, 2016 as year, distracted_accidents FROM distracted_2016
) da
JOIN state_names sn ON da.state_number = sn.state_number
JOIN state_population sp ON da.state_number = CAST(sp.state_fips AS INT64)
ORDER BY da.year, rate_per_100k DESC

WITH weather_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    state_name,
    atmospheric_conditions_name,
    COUNT(*) AS accident_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2016`
  WHERE year_of_crash = 2016
    AND day_of_week IN (1, 7)  -- weekends: Sunday=1, Saturday=7
    AND atmospheric_conditions_name IN ('Clear', 'Rain')
  GROUP BY state_name, atmospheric_conditions_name
)
SELECT 
  state_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN atmospheric_conditions_name = 'Rain' THEN accident_count ELSE 0 END) AS rainy_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN atmospheric_conditions_name = 'Clear' THEN accident_count ELSE 0 END) AS clear_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN atmospheric_conditions_name = 'Rain' THEN accident_count ELSE 0 END) - 
  SUM(CASE WHEN atmospheric_conditions_name = 'Clear' THEN accident_count ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM weather_counts
GROUP BY state_name
ORDER BY ABS(difference) DESC

WITH natality AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) as birth_year, 
         County_of_Residence_FIPS,
         SUM(CASE WHEN Maternal_Morbidity_YN = 1 THEN Births ELSE 0 END) as no_morbidity_births,
         SUM(Births) as total_births
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_maternal_morbidity`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) IN (2016, 2017, 2018)
  GROUP BY birth_year, County_of_Residence_FIPS
),
pct AS (
  SELECT birth_year, County_of_Residence_FIPS,
         CAST(no_morbidity_births AS FLOAT64) / NULLIF(total_births, 0) as pct_no_morbidity
  FROM natality
),
census_2015 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2015_5yr`
),
census_2016 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2016_5yr`
),
census_2017 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr`
),
combined AS (
  SELECT p.birth_year, p.pct_no_morbidity, c.poverty_rate
  FROM pct p
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT geo_id, poverty_rate, 2016 as census_year FROM census_2015
    UNION ALL
    SELECT geo_id, poverty_rate, 2017 as census_year FROM census_2016
    UNION ALL
    SELECT geo_id, poverty_rate, 2018 as census_year FROM census_2017
  ) c ON p.County_of_Residence_FIPS = c.geo_id AND p.birth_year = c.census_year
  WHERE c.poverty_rate IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  birth_year as year,
  CORR(poverty_rate, pct_no_morbidity) as pearson_correlation
FROM combined
GROUP BY birth_year
ORDER BY birth_year

WITH users_2021 AS (

),
user_first_question AS (
  SELECT

    MIN(p.creation_date) AS first_question_date
  FROM users_2021 u
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` p ON u.user_id = p.owner_user_id
  WHERE p.creation_date BETWEEN u.creation_date AND TIMESTAMP_ADD(u.creation_date, INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  GROUP BY u.user_id, u.creation_date, u.signup_month
),
user_first_answer_after_first_question AS (
  SELECT 
    uq.user_id,
    uq.first_question_date,
    MIN(a.creation_date) AS first_answer_date
  FROM user_first_question uq
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a ON uq.user_id = a.owner_user_id
  WHERE a.creation_date > uq.first_question_date
    AND a.creation_date <= TIMESTAMP_ADD(uq.first_question_date, INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  GROUP BY uq.user_id, uq.first_question_date
),
total_users_per_month AS (
  SELECT 
    signup_month,
    COUNT(*) AS total_new_users
  FROM users_2021
  GROUP BY signup_month
),
asked_question_per_month AS (
  SELECT 
    signup_month,
    COUNT(*) AS users_asked_question
  FROM user_first_question
  GROUP BY signup_month
),
answered_question_per_month AS (
  SELECT 
    uq.signup_month,

  FROM user_first_question uq
  JOIN user_first_answer_after_first_question ua ON uq.user_id = ua.user_id
  GROUP BY uq.signup_month
)
SELECT

FROM total_users_per_month t
LEFT JOIN asked_question_per_month a ON t.signup_month = a.signup_month
LEFT JOIN answered_question_per_month e ON t.signup_month = e.signup_month
ORDER BY t.signup_month

WITH purchase_events AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    (SELECT value.int_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'ga_session_id') AS ga_session_id,
    ecommerce.purchase_revenue_in_usd
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201101' AND '20201130'
    AND event_name = 'purchase'
    AND ecommerce.purchase_revenue_in_usd IS NOT NULL
),
session_purchases AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    ga_session_id,
    SUM(purchase_revenue_in_usd) AS session_revenue
  FROM purchase_events
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id, ga_session_id
),
user_purchase_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    COUNT(*) AS num_purchase_sessions,
    SUM(session_revenue) / COUNT(*) AS avg_revenue_per_session
  FROM session_purchases
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT user_pseudo_id, avg_revenue_per_session
FROM user_purchase_counts
ORDER BY user_pseudo_id

WITH page_data AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location') as page_location
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
    AND event_name = 'page_view'
    AND (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location') IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location') LIKE 'http://shop.googlemerchandisestore.com%%'
      OR (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location') LIKE 'https://shop.googlemerchandisestore.com%%'
    )
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rn,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(page_location, r'^https?://shop\.googlemerchandisestore.com', ''), r'/+', '/') as page_path
  FROM page_data
  GROUP BY page_path
)
SELECT page_path
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 2

WITH first_opens AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    DATE(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(user_first_touch_timestamp)) as first_open_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180901' AND '20181003'
    AND event_name = 'first_open'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id, user_first_touch_timestamp
  HAVING DATE(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(user_first_touch_timestamp)) BETWEEN '2018-09-01' AND '2018-09-30'
),
uninstalls AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    fo.user_pseudo_id,
    fo.first_open_date,
    DATE(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(e.event_timestamp)) as uninstall_date
  FROM first_opens fo
  JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON fo.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
    AND e.event_name = 'app_remove'
    AND e._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180901' AND '20181003'
    AND DATE_DIFF(DATE(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(e.event_timestamp)), fo.first_open_date, DAY) BETWEEN 0 AND 7
),
crash_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    u.user_pseudo_id,
    CASE WHEN c.user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as had_crash
  FROM uninstalls u
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
    FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180901' AND '20181003'
      AND event_name = 'app_exception'
  ) c ON u.user_pseudo_id = c.user_pseudo_id
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_uninstalled,
  SUM(had_crash) as had_crash_count,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(had_crash), COUNT(*)) * 100 as percentage
FROM crash_users
